snippet.title: Lootale Slash | Official Trailer | Pixel Art Online Action MMORPG
snippet.description:
Lootale Slash is a free to play pixel art online action MMORPG with an open world, 7 classes, loot, pets and PvP.

Play free on mobile and desktop: https://lootaleslash.com/
Wishlist on Steam (coming December 2026): https://store.steampowered.com/app/5253350/Lootale_Slash/
Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/uCU8FQTMyx
